state_binding.freshness: PRIOR V43 POINT EVIDENCE PRESERVED; NO FRESH LIVE CAD STATE CLAIMED; REQUIRE FRESH REBIND BEFORE ANY CAD-SPECIFIC TEST

intent: Select a physically plausible bottle-handling architecture by comparing multiple mechanism families against the same entry, capture, controlled-rotation, reaction-force, label-transfer, release, neighbor-clearance, and mounting obligations around genuine CAB hardware. Do not assume the current V43 Prism chain is the required mechanism.

projected_steps.title: Freeze the function-first obligation set and preserve current evidence boundaries without selecting a mechanism
expected_outputs: common functional requirement matrix for bottle entry, capture, restraint, controlled rotation, reaction path, label transfer, release, clearance and mounting
explicit separation of verified evidence, deterministic calculations, hypotheses and unresolved fields
V43 retained as candidate evidence, not architecture authority

projected_steps.title: Compare multiple bottle-handling mechanism families against the same bounded requirements
expected_outputs: candidate-family comparison covering V43 Prism chain, driven wrap belt with passive supports, translating pressure-wall or side-belt closure, and indexed cradle/clamp
explicit unknowns and failure modes for each candidate
no ranking by visual plausibility alone

projected_steps.title: Define the minimum deterministic geometry and state-transition tests needed to discriminate surviving candidates
expected_outputs: high-information deterministic tests for capture, rotation, reaction, label-transfer timing, release and whole-body clearance

projected_steps.title: Select a candidate for deterministic CAD sandbox construction only after the comparison supports it
expected_outputs: candidate-selection rationale tied to evidence and deterministic requirements
separate bounded CAD write proposal if new geometry is justified
no CAD mutation under PLAN-0010 itself

acceptance_gate: No mechanism family is mechanically accepted by this plan. A candidate may advance only after deterministic geometry/state checks address entry, capture, bottle restraint, rotation source, reaction-force path, label-transfer relationship, release, neighbor/whole-body clearance, and mounting/support integrity.
no_write_boundary: No move, rebuild, save, mate, suppression, insertion, transform assignment, geometry creation, or Remote Queue write is authorized by this plan.
